title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Requirements:

  • ETL/ELT Development: Proficiency in Python scripting and dbt to build and maintain modular data transformation pipelines.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing: Experience with Amazon Redshift , including SQL development and basic performance tuning
  • Workflow Orchestration: Ability to develop and monitor Apache Airflow DAGs to ensure reliable task scheduling.
  • AWS Managed Services: Familiarity with AWS Glue , S3, and the broader AWS ecosystem for serverless data processing.
  • Logic Translation: Capability to adapt Informatica ETL logic or similar legacy tool patterns into modern code-based workflows.
  • Engineering Standards: Solid understanding of Git version control and data modeling fundamentals.

title: Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer


The Opportunity


We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics SaaS company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.


Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3PLs, and carriers.


They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.


The Role


Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.


What You'll Do


  • Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
  • Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
  • Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
  • Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
  • Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
  • Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR



What We're Looking For


Required:


  • 15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
  • Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
  • Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
  • Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
  • Native-level English and executive-level presence
  • Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers


You'll thrive in this role if you:


  • Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
  • Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
  • Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
  • Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain


This is not the right fit if you:

  • Come from a mid-market or non-logistics SaaS background
  • Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
  • Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
  • Have never built or managed a revenue team

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Solutions Architect – Sao Paulo / Hybrid - Fluent French & English

(Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, Software Implementation, Solutions Architecture, SaaS, Architecture, API Integrations, REST, Web Services, CRM, eCommerce, ERP, OMS, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant)


Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. They have been a market leader within the fintech consultancy sector for many years and their worldwide client base has never been stronger, with significant growth in the last 12 months. They are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to own the end-to-end solution design, implement their cloud-based space planning and design platforms and ensure solution integrity from discovery through deployment.


As an experienced Solutions Architect, you will be responsible for providing architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations and leading architectural discovery sessions with customer stakeholders. This will include designing end-to-end solution architectures across SaaS platforms, APIs, middleware, CRM, eCommerce, and Order Management systems.


Expert knowledge of cloud-based SaaS architecture and API integrations, such as REST and Web Services is essential, as experience leading enterprise-level software implementations. Experience working in multi-system ecosystems, such as CRM, eCommerce, ERP and OMS is also expected. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be acting as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers and presenting solution designs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English.


We are keen to hear from talented Solutions Architect candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.


Location: Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English


To apply for this position please send your CV to Karan Gajjar at Noir Consulting.

title: DevOps - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: DevOps - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Obrigatório

  • Conhecimentos básicos em Linux (terminal, análise de logs e processos)
  • Lógica de programação e/ou scripting (Python, Bash ou similar)
  • Noções de Git (clone, commit, pull request)
  • Conceitos iniciais de automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Conhecimento conceitual sobre containers e Kubernetes/OpenShift
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de arquivos YAML





O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Driven Platforms)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong experience designing, building, and scaling modern web applications and SaaS platforms. In this role, you will work across the entire stack, from intuitive frontend interfaces to robust backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver high-impact, scalable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and scale full-stack web applications and SaaS platforms
  • Build high-quality, maintainable frontend experiences using modern frameworks
  • Develop APIs and backend services with a focus on performance, security, and scalability
  • Architect and manage cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
  • Implement AI-powered features using foundation models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures
  • Ensure reliability through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and observability best practices
  • Collaborate in English on a daily basis with cross-functional and international teams

Technical Requirements

Frontend

  • Strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Proficiency with modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS

Backend

  • Solid experience with Node.js (Express and/or NestJS) and/or Python (FastAPI or Django)

Databases

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or AWS Aurora
  • Experience with Vector Data Stores (Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or Pinecone)

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deep familiarity with AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway) or GCP
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK)

AI & Orchestration

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock (working with foundation models like Claude or Llama)
  • Experience with Google Vertex AI
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and RAG architectures

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Experience with Docker and GitLab CI
  • Strong knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, and Google Cloud Logging

Testing

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, or Cypress

Developer Tools

  • Advanced proficiency with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitLab Duo, and Claude Code

Language Requirements

  • Advanced English proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview

We’re hiring a hands-on Platform / DevOps Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.


You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement .


What You’ll Do

  • Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
  • Manage Kubernetes environments : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting
  • Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred; Jenkins/GitHub Actions acceptable)
  • Maintain and improve self-service workflows , templates, and developer “golden paths”
  • Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, OpenTelemetry ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality
  • Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing
  • Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
  • Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response
  • Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability
  • Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years in Platform Engineering / DevOps / SRE / Infrastructure roles
  • Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Deep Kubernetes expertise :
  • Operating and maintaining clusters
  • Experience building Kubernetes environments
  • Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling
  • Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong Linux fundamentals
  • Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GitLab CI
  • Exposure to OpenTelemetry
  • API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
  • Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers)
  • Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows
  • Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
  • Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations


What We’re NOT Looking For

  • No Kubernetes experience ❌
  • Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌
  • Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌
  • Pure security-focused candidates ❌
  • Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌
  • ML/Data Science profiles ❌


Team Structure

  • 1 Principal Engineer
  • 1 Senior Engineer
  • 1 Engineer (India)
  • You = 4th key team member

title: Snowflake Developer
description:
Job Title: Snowflake Engineer

Location: Remote



Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Snowflake Engineer with strong expertise in cloud data warehousing and ETL/ELT pipeline development. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Snowflake, GCP BigQuery, and modern data engineering tools to build scalable, efficient, and high-performing data solutions across hybrid cloud environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Support and maintain existing Snowflake workflows to ensure reliability and performance.
  • Operate, stabilize, and optimize migrated BigQuery workflows.
  • Integrate international business logic into global data pipelines to enable scalability and standardization.
  • Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake environments.
  • Develop and implement data quality checks, validation logic, and reconciliation processes.
  • Optimize pipeline performance, compute usage, storage tiering, and query costs, particularly in BigQuery.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all data pipelines and workflows.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support analytics and reporting needs.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • Strong experience with Snowflake and GCP BigQuery
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow and Cloud Composer
  • Experience with GitHub , CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts:
  • Star Schema
  • Dimensional Modeling
  • OLTP vs OLAP
  • Experience working with Adobe data platforms (preferred)

Technical Expertise

  • ETL/ELT pipeline development in hybrid cloud environments (AWS & GCP)
  • Workflow orchestration and scheduling
  • Performance tuning and cost optimization
  • Data integration and transformation at scale

title: Software Engineer
description:
Title: Software Engineer

Location: Remote in Brazil

Type: Full-time (CLT)


Job Description:

  • Pipeline Development & Migration: Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines across hybrid environments (AWS, GCP, Snowflake). A primary focus will be the migration and expansion of Adobe-based pipelines.
  • Data Integration: Lead the integration of Orion datasets into existing architectures and create new pipelines for Orion Event collection.
  • Performance Optimization: Proactively optimize pipeline runtimes, compute usage, and storage tiering. You will be responsible for managing query costs, with a specific emphasis on BigQuery optimization.
  • Data Integrity: Establish and automate rigorous data quality checks, validation logic, and reconciliation processes to ensure \"single source of truth\" reliability.
  • Architecture & Documentation: Apply advanced data warehousing concepts (Star Schemas, Dimensional Modeling) to structure data for high-performance OLAP needs. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for all developed systems.


Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • Overall Experience: 5-8 years of professional experience in the technology sector.
  • Engineering Expertise: 5-8 years of direct, applicable experience in Data Engineering or Backend Engineering.


Technical Skills & Competencies


The GCP Stack & Orchestration:

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Expert-level proficiency in BigQuery.
  • Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow and Google Cloud Composer.
  • DevOps: Strong mastery of GitHub and CI/CD workflows for automated data deployments.

Programming & Languages:

  • Python: Advanced proficiency for data manipulation and automation.
  • SQL: Expert level for complex analytical querying and transformation.

Data Modeling & Design:

  • Warehousing Concepts: Deep understanding of Star Schemas and Dimensional Modeling.
  • Systems Knowledge: Clear understanding of the trade-offs between OLTP vs. OLAP environments.
  • Hybrid Cloud: Experience moving and transforming data across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director


Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.


Compensation:

  • $40,000-90,000 USD per year.


Duties & Responsibilities:


Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.

title: QA (Quality Assurance) – Web3 / Exchange
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) QA (Quality Assurance) para atuar de forma estratégica e operacional na validação de um produto Web3.

O profissional será responsável não apenas por testes, mas também por garantir a qualidade geral da experiência do usuário, com visão crítica sobre fluxos, usabilidade e funcionamento do sistema.

Responsabilidades
  • Testar funcionalidades da plataforma (web e mobile)
  • Identificar, documentar e acompanhar bugs
  • Validar fluxos completos de uso (ex: login, conexão de wallet, swaps, transações)
  • Garantir que novas atualizações não quebrem funcionalidades existentes
  • Avaliar experiência do usuário com foco em simplicidade e clareza
  • Simular comportamentos reais de usuários (inclusive iniciantes)
  • Trabalhar próximo ao time de desenvolvimento para validação de entregas
  • Auxiliar na criação de metas mensais da equipe
  • Acompanhar resultados e consistência das entregas
  • Sugerir melhorias baseadas em análise prática do produto
Requisitos
  • Experiência como QA (manual ou automatizado)
  • Conhecimento em Web3, wallets e exchanges cripto (obrigatório)
  • Entendimento de como usuários interagem com produtos cripto
  • Capacidade de identificar problemas de UX e fluxos confusos
  • Organização para documentar testes e bugs de forma clara
  • Perfil crítico e detalhista
  • Capacidade de pensar como usuário final
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com testes automatizados
  • Já ter utilizado exchanges, DEXs ou wallets no dia a dia
  • Noção de redes blockchain (EVM, taxas, transações, etc.)
  • Experiência com produtos voltados para usuários iniciantes
Modelo de trabalho

title: Senior Web Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company:  Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type:  Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Global Campus Outreach Partner
description:
We are looking for dynamic and well-connected individuals within the university ecosystem to help expand our student contributor network for AI/LLM evaluation projects.


As a Country Campus Outreach Partner, you will play a key role in connecting with universities, student communities, and academic networks to onboard qualified students interested in flexible AI-related gig opportunities.


This is an ideal opportunity for individuals passionate about AI, education, and community building, while gaining exposure to the global AI ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations within your country.
  • Promote SME on demand/short term AI & LLM centric opportunities to university students.
  • Identify and engage student ambassadors and academic contacts to expand outreach.
  • Conduct virtual information sessions or campus awareness activities.
  • Support onboarding and orientation of new student contributors.
  • Track outreach progress and provide monthly updates on engagement and onboarding metrics.
  • Ensure a steady pipeline of qualified student participants for gig projects.


Success Metrics for the given role:


  • Number of universities engaged
  • Number of student contributors onboarded
  • Engagement sessions conducted
  • Active participation and task completion by onboarded students

title: Data Engineer GCP |  Snowflake
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (GCP BigQuery & Snowflake)

Location: Remote



Job Summary


We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines across cloud platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in GCP (BigQuery), Snowflake, and Python , along with a solid foundation in data warehousing concepts and modern DevOps practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support and maintain existing Snowflake workflows and data pipelines
  • Operate, monitor, and stabilize migrated BigQuery workflows
  • Integrate international business logic into global data pipelines to ensure scalability and standardization
  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines across hybrid environments (AWS, GCP, Snowflake )
  • Implement data quality checks, validation logic, and reconciliation processes
  • Optimize pipeline performance, compute usage, storage, and query costs (especially in BigQuery)
  • Develop and maintain documentation for all data pipelines and workflows
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision making
  • Follow and contribute to modern DevOps practices , including CI/CD and version control


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline
  • 12–15 years of overall IT experience
  • 7–9 years of hands-on data engineering experience


Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with:
  • GCP BigQuery
  • Snowflake
  • Python & SQL
  • Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer

title: E-2 Visa Specialist
description:
Company Description


Robinson Immigration Law is a boutique law firm that guides global talent, investors, and founders through the U.S. immigration process so that they can build their future in the United States. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, the firm serves clients across the U.S. and globally, offering fully remote services. Robinson Immigration Law creates tailored immigration strategies based on each client’s long-term goals.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for an E-2 Visa Specialist. The Specialist will be responsible for guiding clients through the E-2 visa application process, including reviewing financial and business documentation, drafting strong submissions, and addressing any legal concerns in collaboration with attorneys. The role involves managing client communications, conducting case research, and maintaining compliance with immigration regulations to ensure successful application outcomes.


Qualifications


  • Strong knowledge of E-2 visa requirements and U.S. immigration law, with experience in investment and business-based immigration pathways.
  • Proficient in reviewing financial and business documents and preparing detailed and accurate visa application submissions.
  • Excellent written communication and document preparation skills, including drafting business plans and legal statements.
  • Strong client management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate with individuals from diverse professional and cultural backgrounds.
  • Attention to detail and ability to perform thorough legal research to ensure compliance and effective case documentation.
  • Bachelor’s degree or advanced education in law, business, or a related field is preferred.
  • Proficiency in remote collaboration tools and the ability to work autonomously in a remote environment.


The firm operates fully remotely, so candidates are invited to apply regardless of location.


We provide competitive compensation with performance incentives, a fully remote career opportunity, a collaborative work environment, and opportunities for growth and advancement.


We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Marketing Track)
description:
Work Remotely, Part-time, Internship


We want “Campus Connectors”—social, trend-aware, creative students who can link us with campus creators, produce viral content, and run fun events to make our brand pop on campus.


What You’ll Do:

● Get to know Your Peers: Track the real needs and content preferences of students from different backgrounds (like international students) continuously.

● Create Engaging Content Together: Participate in planning and producing social media content, and discover and collaborate with rising campus stars.

● Plan and Launch Fun Events: Help organize and support promotional events or collaborations that elevate brand activity and impact on campus.



We Hope You Are:

● A campus socializer: You're active in clubs and events, with a lot of friends online and offline, making you a key influencer.

● Trendy Visual Content Creator: You love snapping photos, editing videos, and are passionate about visual trends in fashion, beauty, and more.

● Operations Savvy: You have knowledge of managing social media and engaging with student behaviors and cultural trends.



Bonus Points If You Have:

● Relevant studies in fields like media, fashion, marketing, or sociology.

● Have content creation experience: run your own social account or create content regularly.

● Understand youth culture in regions like Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, Europe, or the US.

● Leadership experience in clubs or project organization on campus.



What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design


Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Offer Details:


Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home)

Contract Duration: 12 months

Number of Open Positions: 20


Key Qualifications

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process -

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


How to Apply?

Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62131 as your email subject.

title: Desenvolvedor full stake
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor Full Stack


Sobre o Wite Group / WiteTec

O Wite Group é uma empresa focada em construção de produtos digitais com alto nível de exigência, responsabilidade e impacto direto no negócio. Atuamos com projetos robustos em ambientes competitivos como SaaS, plataformas transacionais e soluções escaláveis. Aqui, não existe espaço para execução superficial — buscamos profissionais que entendam o peso de colocar algo em produção e sustentar isso com consistência.


Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Full Stack com forte capacidade de execução, visão de produto e responsabilidade sobre o que entrega. Essa pessoa não será apenas um executor de tarefas, mas alguém capaz de entender o contexto do negócio, propor soluções e garantir estabilidade, performance e evolução contínua das aplicações.


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações front-end e back-end

• Trabalhar com arquiteturas escaláveis e organizadas

• Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e estruturais

• Garantir qualidade de código, testes e performance

• Integrar sistemas, APIs e serviços externos

• Identificar problemas e propor melhorias contínuas

• Atuar com autonomia, sem necessidade de microgerenciamento


Requisitos técnicos (Hard Skills)

• Domínio de desenvolvimento front-end (ex: React, Vue ou similar)

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description:
B2B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call)


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


Apply Here (See Instructions Below)


(


The Opportunity: Why GP Socials


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role


You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

Um grande banco, referência no mercado, está expandindo e estruturando um novo modelo de atuação no segmento Upper Middle Market , aliando Corporate Banking, crédito estruturado e inovação comercial , com foco em uma experiência diferenciada para clientes empresariais e processos escaláveis para o banco.

Buscamos um(a) Banker Upper Middle ou Corporate com perfil Hunter, forte atuação em originação de negócios , que queira liderar a construção de um novo segmento , com alta visibilidade interna e impacto direto no crescimento da instituição.


Principais Atribuições

  • Prospecção ativa (Hunter) e abertura de relacionamento com clientes Upper Middle Market ou Corporate.
  • Originação, estruturação e fechamento de operações de crédito corporativo ;

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (GCP / BigQuery / Adobe Pipelines)

Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in GCP, BigQuery, and data pipeline development . The ideal candidate will play a key role in building, optimizing, and scaling data pipelines, while supporting Adobe-based data integrations and Orion dataset expansion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead migration and expansion of Adobe-based data pipelines
  • Integrate Orion datasets into existing data platforms
  • Design and develop new pipelines for Orion event data collection
  • Build, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines across hybrid environments (AWS, GCP, Snowflake )
  • Implement data quality checks, validation logic, and reconciliation processes
  • Optimize BigQuery performance , including runtime, compute usage, and cost efficiency
  • Work with Airflow / Composer for workflow orchestration
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable data solutions
  • Maintain proper documentation for all data pipelines and processes

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • 12–15 years of overall IT experience
  • 7–9 years of hands-on data engineering experience
  • Strong expertise in:
  • GCP BigQuery
  • Python & SQL
  • Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer
  • GitHub & CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with Adobe data platforms / pipelines
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Data Warehousing concepts
  • Star Schema & Dimensional Modeling
  • OLTP vs OLAP systems

title: \"Gerente de Projetos SAP #1001371\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um dos maiores grupos industriais do Brasil, com forte atuação global e foco em transformação digital e excelência operacional.

O projeto está inserido no Centro de Excelência SAP, com atuação estratégica na sustentação e evolução de soluções corporativas, além da liderança de iniciativas de alta complexidade e impacto no negócio.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Gerenciar projetos SAP de diferentes complexidades (locais e corporativos)
  • Conduzir pré-projetos (RFPs, estimativas, equalizações e pareceres técnicos)
  • Planejar escopo, cronograma, custos e riscos dos projetos

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description:
PLEASE READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING


Metrobi is a VC-backed startup and an alumni of Techstars Boston, one of the leading accelerators in the USA.


We power deliveries for local food and beverage businesses in Boston, New York, DC, Chicago, LA, and other major metropolitan areas. Our technology is at the center of our delivery marketplace.


Intro video:


Why should you join Metrobi?

  • Play a key role in shaping performance marketing strategy.
  • Fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with plenty of room to test & learn.
  • Opportunity to directly impact conversions and revenue.
  • International team experience and a supportive work environment.
  • A well-funded company that offers competitive compensation.
  • An opportunity to learn every day in a fast-paced environment.
  • A chance to become a part of a dynamic company on a fast track to change the logistics scene in the US.


About the role

We’re looking for a data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist who loves experimenting, optimizing, and scaling growth. If you enjoy working with WordPress and creating compelling content for emails and landing pages, this role is for you.


  • Professional English Proficiency is a must.
  • Hiring interviews will be conducted online.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and iterate on landing pages (WordPress + Elementor), testing buttons, hero texts, CTAs, and layouts.
  • Run A/B tests & experiments to improve conversion rates continuously.
  • Track, analyze, and report performance.
  • Understand the audience and work on improving the copy from email marketing campaigns.


Musts

We're looking for someone with hands-on experience in:

  • Proven track record of generating leads organically through inbound marketing (will be verified during interviews)
  • WordPress & Elementor
  • SEO
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and A/B testing
  • Email marketing campaign content creation
  • Landing page creation
  • 3+ years of experience in B2B markets


This is a senior role requiring demonstrated expertise in B2B inbound organic lead generation.


This role is not for you if:

  • You have only worked with Ads and paid media before.
  • You have only worked for marketing agencies before
  • You don't have any experience with generating leads and measuring the results.


Nice to have:

  • Basic HTML/CSS
  • Understanding of UI/UX principles for better user journeys.
  • Experience with Google Ads / Meta Ads / LinkedIn Ads
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets


  • This is a remote position.
  • Must be able to work between (9AM-6PM EST)

title: Server Manager (Global Project)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Nesta função, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos, solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos

  • Expertise em Linux: Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.

title: Project Manager- operations (Remote Latam)
description:
Role Summary

As Avanto scales our 300-person workforce, the efficiency of our internal operations is critical. We are seeking a highly structured, assertive Project Manager to drive our internal strategic initiatives across Operations, HR, and cross-functional departments.

We are continuously advancing how we operate through automation and emerging AI capabilities, and this role plays a key part in driving those efficiencies across the organization.

This role is the antidote to \"scope creep\" and undocumented meetings. We need a driver who can step into ambiguous strategic discussions, extract the concrete deliverables, define the scope, and relentlessly manage the execution. While you will not be managing client deployments or writing software code, you will act as the crucial link between our operational leaders and our internal systems/support teams. You will ensure that before we implement a new workflow or build a new internal tool, the business requirements are meticulously documented and agreed upon.

Key Responsibilities

Scope Capture & Definition

  • Own the Meeting Outcome: Attend internal strategy and planning meetings to act as the definitive owner of project scope. Ensure no meeting ends without documented consensus on exactly what is being executed, who owns it, and the timeline.
  • Translate Strategy to Action: Take high-level concepts from operations and HR leaders and distill them into strict, clear, and executable project plans.
  • Prevent Scope Creep: Act as the gatekeeper for internal initiatives, ensuring that any additions to a project's scope are properly vetted, documented, and given updated timelines.

Operations & Systems Liaison

  • Define Business Requirements: Partner with Operations to map out current workflows, identify bottlenecks, and document clear business requirements for new tools or processes.
  • Guide Systems Implementation: Manage the rollout of both off-the-shelf operational solutions and custom-built internal tools.
  • Support Internal Builders: Ensure that our internal development/systems support teams are only handed fully scoped, approved, and documented business requirements, preventing ad-hoc interruptions and misaligned builds.

Internal Project Leadership & Execution

  • Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Manage complex internal initiatives—such as operational restructuring, HR program launches, or new system integrations—from inception to completion.
  • Hold Stakeholders Accountable: Competently and confidently follow up with internal stakeholders at all levels (including Directors and VPs) to ensure tasks and dependencies are completed on time.
  • Maintain the Source of Truth: Build and maintain comprehensive project boards and dashboards (using Jira, Notion, etc.) so leadership has real-time visibility into internal project health.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Assertive Stakeholder Management: You are not afraid to hold department heads accountable to their deadlines. You can lead laterally without formal reporting authority.
  • Exceptional Scope Discipline: A proven track record of taking ambiguous business conversations and locking them down into clear, documented project scopes.
  • Business Process Mapping: You naturally see how to organize chaos into a step-by-step workflow and can clearly articulate how an operation should function.
  • Tool Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in project management and documentation tools like Jira, Notion, Asana, or Monday.com
  • Communication: Direct, clear, and highly organized written and verbal communication.
  • Experience leveraging automation or AI tools to improve workflows is preferred

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 3–6 years of project management experience, with a heavy emphasis on internal operations, process improvement, or business systems implementation.
  • Cross-Departmental Exposure: Proven experience running projects that span multiple internal departments (e.g., HR, IT, Operations).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Project Management, or a related field.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Internal Delivery Rate: Percentage of internal operational projects delivered within planned timelines.
  • Scope Fidelity: Accuracy of initial project documentation and the minimization of undocumented post-kickoff changes.
  • Process Adoption: Successful rollout and sustained adoption of new internal workflows and operational systems.


Salary: $1,500-2,000 monthly USD

About Apex Brands:

We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced, self-sufficient Email & SMS Marketing Specialist who can fully own the strategy, copy, design, and execution of retention campaigns across multiple accounts.


Role Overview:

We're looking for a full-stack lifecycle marketer—someone who can strategize, write, design, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns end-to-end. You’ll be the go-to expert responsible for delivering results across Klaviyo, Postscript, and other tools, and will manage the full lifecycle marketing function for several eCommerce brands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Campaign Creation and Client Calendar Planning From A–Z : Develop a campaign calendar for brands assigned to you and execute email and SMS campaigns including strategy, segmentation, copywriting, design layout, scheduling, and testing.


  • Build Automations & Flows: Set up and maintain high-converting flows such as Welcome, Abandon Cart, Browse Abandonment, Winback, Post-Purchase, etc.


  • Design Beautiful, On-Brand Emails: Use Figma or another editor of your choice (or custom code if needed) to design emails that look great on mobile and desktop—and convert.


  • Write Strategic, On-Brand Copy: Craft subject lines, preview text, and body copy that aligns with the brand voice and drives action.


  • Run A/B Tests & Optimize: Continuously test and refine subject lines, send times, content blocks, and CTAs to improve performance.


  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.


  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.


  • Client Communication: Hop on strategy calls or send Looms explaining performance, roadmap, and ideas to clients.


Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

  • $1500 - $6000 USD per month

title: Cloud Security Engineer Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Cloud Security Engineer para integrar nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será referência técnica em segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on na proteção de ambientes digitais complexos — com foco em pipelines seguros, desenvolvimento seguro e ambientes multicloud.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Projetar e revisar arquiteturas seguras para aplicações web, APIs e sites, identificando vulnerabilidades e propondo melhorias estruturais.
  • Configurar, evoluir e automatizar pipelines CI/CD no GitLab com integração de ferramentas de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning), garantindo que segurança faça parte do fluxo de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (Secure SDLC), conduzindo análises de código e orientações sobre boas práticas de segurança.
  • Criar automações para monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes, reduzindo a superfície de ataque de forma contínua.
  • Atuar na segurança de infraestruturas multicloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP), incluindo IAM, gestão de segredos, redes e conformidade com políticas de segurança.
  • Colaborar com squads e stakeholders técnicos para disseminar cultura de segurança, participar de revisões de arquitetura e contribuir proativamente com soluções inovadoras.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre o cenário de ameaças, CVEs relevantes e novas tecnologias de segurança, trazendo insights para o time.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência com threat modeling, revisão de arquitetura de apps e sites, e conhecimento de OWASP Top 10 e boas práticas de segurança em APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Domínio avançado de GitLab CI/CD, com experiência em configurar stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection) e integrar ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de práticas como code review com foco em segurança, análise de dependências vulneráveis, gestão de segredos e políticas de controle de acesso.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver scripts, playbooks e automações (Python, Bash ou similares) para triagem de alertas, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes.
  • Experiência em ao menos um provedor (AWS, Azure ou GCP) com foco em IAM, segurança de redes, gestão de segredos (Vault, KMS) e conformidade (CIS Benchmarks, CSPM).
  • Familiaridade com OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Prowler ou equivalentes.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Conhecimento de frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001 ou SOC 2.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Cloud Security Engineer para integrar nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será referência técnica em segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on na proteção de ambientes digitais complexos — com foco em pipelines seguros, desenvolvimento seguro e ambientes multicloud.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Projetar e revisar arquiteturas seguras para aplicações web, APIs e sites, identificando vulnerabilidades e propondo melhorias estruturais.

  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre o cenário de ameaças, CVEs relevantes e novas tecnologias de segurança, trazendo insights para o time.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência com threat modeling, revisão de arquitetura de apps e sites, e conhecimento de OWASP Top 10 e boas práticas de segurança em APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Domínio avançado de GitLab CI/CD, com experiência em configurar stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection) e integrar ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de práticas como code review com foco em segurança, análise de dependências vulneráveis, gestão de segredos e políticas de controle de acesso.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver scripts, playbooks e automações (Python, Bash ou similares) para triagem de alertas, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes.
  • Experiência em ao menos um provedor (AWS, Azure ou GCP) com foco em IAM, segurança de redes, gestão de segredos (Vault, KMS) e conformidade (CIS Benchmarks, CSPM).
  • Familiaridade com OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Prowler ou equivalentes.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Conhecimento de frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001 ou SOC 2.
