title: Technical Account Manager, Hybrid São Paulo
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is a leading B2B ecosystem player in the TravelTech space, connecting and empowering businesses in the ever-evolving world of travel. We drive growth for our clients and partners while removing friction from the end-to-end travel experience. Our cloud-based technology platforms offer fast and reliable access to a unique portfolio of travel products & services, while rich data and intelligence seamlessly connect supply and demand worldwide.


We have over more than 3,000 experts worldwide, including specialists on the ground who provide insights and support to boost trading even further, especially in the most hard-to-reach segments. This unique blend of technology, data and passionate people serves as a catalyst for all businesses aiming to unlock their full potential in the travel arena.


HBX Group comprises four best-in-class B2B brands that meet the needs of its growing and diverse client base across 190+ global markets:


- Hotelbeds, who cater for the specific needs of hoteliers, tour operators, airlines and online travel agents


- Bedsonline, exclusively serving the retail travel segment


- Roiback, the HotelTech partner for independent hotels and chains seeking growth through direct channel solutions


- TravelStack, providing all products, services and solutions to businesses looking to enter into the lucrative travel arena.


Job Summary


We are looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) with a strong technology foundation and a proven ability to deliver strategic solutions for enterprise clients. This role combines technical expertise with customer-centric account management , ensuring seamless integration, optimization, and long-term success for our most strategic partners.

As a TAM, you will act as a trusted advisor , building strong relationships with key accounts, driving technical excellence, and collaborating across global teams. You will lead technical engagements, oversee API client optimization, and provide proactive solutions that align with business objectives. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and is passionate about solving complex technical challenges.


Job Responsibilities


Territory Growth & Development

  • Partner with sales teams to position and deliver technical solutions to strategic customers through presentations, demos, evaluations, and technical objection handling.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for key accounts, ensuring smooth communication and integration.
  • Maximize product adoption and distribution from a technical perspective .

Solution Delivery & Optimization

  • Lead all technical activities related to customer onboarding and API integrations.
  • Provide post-sales technical support , troubleshoot issues, and resolve complex cases.
  • Analyze client performance and define optimization strategies to drive efficiency and scalability.
  • Develop scripts and automation tools to monitor, alert, and report on production environments.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Work closely with internal teams and external partners to align technical requirements with business goals.
  • Participate in global and regional projects , ensuring timely delivery and accurate reporting.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation and ensure KPIs are consistently met.

Required Skills & Experience


  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering , or related field.
  • Proven experience as a Strategic Technical Account Manager or similar role.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, XML, JSON , and related technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Databases & SQL .
  • Understanding of automation practices across development, build, and deployment phases.
  • Familiarity with build management and CI/CD tools .
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, maintainable documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills , initiative, and ability to work in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience in the Travel Industry is a plus.
  • ADVANCED ENGLISH is a must

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Global Hrbp
description:
About JD's International Business

We are committed to building a digitally intelligent cross-border supply chain and global retail infrastructure. Leveraging our global supply chain capabilities, JD continues to expand in markets where we possess distinct competitive advantages. Our diversified businesses—including retail, logistics, technology, industrial development, manufacturing, and healthcare—are growing in synergy. Currently, JD operates worldwide, with a presence in countries and regions such as China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, serving customers across the globe.


Position Mission

As a core HR partner for our international expansion, you will be at the forefront of our rapidly growing global business. This is not just an HR role—it is a mission to become a "Growth Engine" and "Organizational Architect" for the business. We invest in your future through a unique 6-to-12-month immersive rotation program at our Beijing Headquarters. This program is designed to provide an in-depth understanding of our core business, culture, and operations, empowering you to drive organizational capability, build world-class teams, and ensure our people strategy accelerates our global growth.


Core Responsibilities

1. Global Talent Program: Beijing Headquarters Rotation (6–12 Months)

- Immerse yourself in the core operations, culture, and leadership network of our global business.

- Participate in structured training and mentorship while contributing to key projects in talent acquisition, organizational development, and HR analytics.

- Build a solid foundation and holistic perspective before transitioning to support international business teams.


2. Strategic HR Partnership & Business Insight

- Translate business strategies in international markets (e.G., Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, Middle East) into actionable people strategies.

- Provide forward-looking insights on organizational design, talent density, and cultural integration.


3. Talent Engine & Pipeline Development

- Lead end-to-end recruitment for critical roles in supply chain, warehouse management, cross-border logistics, and localized operations.

- Design and implement talent development initiatives such as the "Global Young Talent Program" to build a robust pipeline of future leaders.


4. Organizational Effectiveness & Team Activation

- Diagnose and optimize organizational structures and processes to enhance collaboration and performance in cross-cultural settings.

- Drive a results-oriented performance management system and leverage HR data to support business decision-making.


5. Global Culture & Employee Experience

- Champion JD’s corporate culture and foster an open, agile, and inclusive team environment across regions.

- Proactively manage employee relations and enhance the end-to-end employee lifecycle experience.


Qualifications & Attributes

We are seeking a future leader with business acumen, an entrepreneurial mindset, and high growth potential—not just a traditional HR practitioner.


Must-Haves

- Bachelor’s degree or above with at least 5 years of HR experience. Experience in internet, e-commerce, retail, logistics, or consulting is preferred.

- Global mindset: Overseas study/work experience or prior exposure to supporting international business is highly advantageous.

- Business acumen: Strong interest and ability to quickly grasp business logic, profitability models, and core challenges.

- Superior cognitive and problem-solving skills:

- Structured thinking: Ability to dissect complex situations and develop clear solution frameworks.

- Data-driven: Skilled in using data analysis to identify issues, validate hypotheses, and drive decisions.

- Drive & resilience:

- Ownership: Takes full responsibility for business challenges and outcomes.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and views challenges as growth opportunities.


Core Competencies

- Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels and cultures.

- A keen eye for identifying and developing high-potential talent.

- Collaborative team player.


What We Offer

- A 6-to-12-month foundational rotation at Beijing Headquarters, connecting you with the core of our business and setting the stage for long-term success.

- A platform at the forefront of international growth, where your contributions directly impact our core strategy.

- Accelerated career growth by solving complex, real-world business challenges from day one.

- An environment of trust and autonomy that encourages bold thinking and innovation.

Indústria de embalagens para o setor alimentício, reconhecida pela qualidade de seus produtos e pelo compromisso com a satisfação dos clientes.

  • Efetuar follow-up de pedidos (E2E) e interface direta com Logística, Supply Chain, Crédito e Cobrança

  • Cadastrar novos clientes com todas as informações necessárias para o correto faturamento

  • Enviar semanalmente a posição financeira para cada cliente, apontando possíveis pendências
  • Acompanhar o andamento de cada processo de exportação, garantindo a realização do embarque
  • Participar de reuniões triangulares (vendedor, técnico e cliente) para melhorar a comunicação e o atendimento


Sobre o Processo Seletivo:

A Claire Joster é a consultoria responsável pelo recrutamento e seleção para esta posição. Os candidatos selecionados serão contatados para dar seguimento ao processo.

WSO2 is looking for a visionary Field CTO to join our Latin American Sales Engineering team. As a company at the forefront of API Management, Integration, and Identity & Access Management (IAM), WSO2 provides the foundational "digital freedom" for enterprises to innovate without vendor lock-in.

The Field CTO is a high-impact, senior-level technology sales professional who acts as the "voice of the technology" in the field. You will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives at our most strategic accounts, providing thought leadership and architectural guidance that aligns WSO2’s open-source and SaaS solutions with our customers' long-term business goals. This is a hybrid role that demands the technical depth of an architect and the influential communication of a senior sales executive.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evangelism & Thought Leadership: Represent WSO2 at major industry conferences, executive roundtables, and in the media. Author white papers, blogs, and reference architectures that define the future of digital transformation and decentralized integration.
  • Strategic Sales Support: Partner with the Latin American sales team to lead "top-down" technical engagements. You will own the technical relationship with CXOs, helping them understand how WSO2 fits into their broader enterprise ecosystem.
  • Architectural Advisory: Provide high-level architectural oversight for strategic pre-sales opportunities and critical post-sales implementations. Ensure that customer deployments are scalable, secure, and follow industry best practices.
  • Market Intelligence & Feedback Loop: Act as a bridge between the Latam market and WSO2 Product Management. Translate customer challenges and market trends into actionable product requirements to influence the roadmap of our internal developer platforms and SaaS offerings.
  • Post-Sales Strategic Alignment: For key accounts, continue to provide periodic executive-level reviews to ensure the realized value of the WSO2 platform and identify expansion opportunities based on the customer’s evolving digital roadmap.
  • Mentorship: Act as a mentor to the broader Sales Engineering team, elevating their ability to communicate business value alongside technical features.

Qualifications, Skills, and Relevant Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in technical sales, enterprise architecture, or professional services, with at least 3 years in a leadership or "Field CTO" equivalent role.
  • Proven track record of selling to and advising Fortune 500 companies within the Latin American or North American market.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep technical knowledge in at least two of the following technical domains: API Management, Enterprise Integration, Microservices, Identity & Access Management (CIAM/IAM), Internal Developer Platforms, and AI
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent business experience is highly desirable.

title: Parts Inventory Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.



About the Role


The Parts Inventory Manager is responsible for managing spare parts and component inventory across multiple Vammo locations. This role ensures accurate stock control for electrical motorcycles, BBoxes, batteries, and related components.


The position leads the inventory team, maintains accurate data in the Warehouse Management System (WMS), and guarantees that physical stock matches system records through regular cycle counts and inventory audits. The role works closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and After-Sales teams to ensure parts availability and operational efficiency.


Key responsibilities include supervising inventory operations, managing stock levels across sites, implementing inventory control processes, and ensuring reliable reporting and traceability of all parts movements.


Hard Skills


  • Inventory management and stock control
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  • Cycle counting and physical inventory audits
  • Inventory reconciliation and discrepancy analysis
  • Supply chain and logistics processes
  • Data analysis and reporting (Excel / ERP / dashboards)
  • Multi-site inventory management
  • Demand planning and stock level optimization
  • Process implementation and standardization
  • Cost optimization in inventory and logistics
  • Experience with motorcycle components and electronic parts.


Soft Skills


  • Leadership and team management
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Problem-solving mindset
  • Attention to detail
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Communication skills
  • Process improvement mindset
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Hands-on mentality ("mão na massa") – willing to dive into operations when needed


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Sobre a Vaga


O Gerente de Estoque é responsável por gerenciar o estoque de peças e componentes em diferentes locais da Vammo. Essa função garante o controle preciso do estoque de motocicletas elétricas, BBoxes, baterias e seus respectivos componentes.


A posição lidera o time de inventário, mantém informações precisas no WMS (Warehouse Management System) e garante que o estoque físico esteja alinhado com os registros do sistema por meio de contagens cíclicas e auditorias de inventário. Essa função trabalha em conjunto com as áreas de Supply Chain, Procurement, Operações e Pós-Vendas para garantir disponibilidade de peças e eficiência operacional.


As principais responsabilidades incluem supervisionar as operações de inventário, gerenciar níveis de estoque em diferentes sites, implementar processos de controle de estoque e garantir relatórios confiáveis e rastreabilidade de todas as movimentações de peças.

This job requires up to 25% global travel.

include the job title in the subject line. Responses will be treated quickly and with strict confidentiality.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Administração de Pessoal capaz de atuar de forma estratégica e operacional, com forte experiência em gestão de pessoas, maturidade de liderança, e condução de projetos de melhoria contínua. Esta posição será responsável tanto por uma célula específica do Departamento Pessoal quanto por liderar iniciativas estruturantes de transformação da área.


Responsabilidades:

  • Supervisionar a execução das atividades, planos de ação e processos estabelecidos pela gerência.
  • Acompanhar e controlar rotinas de administração de pessoal, incluindo:
  • Folha de pagamento;
  • Gestão de férias;
  • Apuração de encargos sociais;
  • FGTS;
  • Contribuições sindical e assistencial;
  • Processos de rescisão e homologação.
  • Apoiar coordenadores em estruturas de maior porte ou elevada complexidade, garantindo a correta execução das rotinas operacionais.
  • Acompanhar a elaboração, conferência e entrega de relatórios anuais obrigatórios (Informe de Rendimentos, DIRF, RAIS), assegurando precisão e conformidade das informações.
  • Orientar sobre o correto recolhimento de encargos e o cumprimento dos procedimentos legais referentes à administração de pessoal.
  • Supervisionar, quando necessário, atividades de serviços gerais, como limpeza, restaurante e jardinagem.
  • Conduzir veículos utilizados nas atividades da área, garantindo uso seguro e eficiente.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de saúde e segurança do trabalho, promovendo o uso adequado de EPIs e EPCs.
  • Organizar, manter e preservar o arquivo do departamento, garantindo boa guarda, conservação e facilidade de consulta dos documentos.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Gestão da Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho.


Formação e Experiência

  • Formação em Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas de RH e supervisão de equipes.
  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista e previdenciária.
  • Domínio de processos de folha de pagamento e encargos.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de RH.
  • Capacidade de supervisão e controle de equipes.
  • Noções de SST (Segurança e Saúde do Trabalho).


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Wellhub
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos 507 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 31 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 19.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Engenheiro (A) Mlops E Llmops
description:
Com 70 anos de existência, o Einstein Hospital Israelita ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação em setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar como MLOps/LLMOps para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, machine learning tradicional e IA generativa. A pessoa será responsável por projetar, implementar e operar pipelines de ML end-to-end, garantindo que modelos e agentes de IA sejam implantados e monitorados em produção com alta confiabilidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

O papel envolve atuar tanto em MLOps, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de modelos treinados com dados proprietários, quanto em LLMOps, lidando com desafios específicos de LLMs, como versionamento de prompts, variabilidade de outputs, otimização de custos de inferência e monitoramento de alucinaçõe


Informações da vaga:

  • Local de trabalho: Unid Centro de Ens e Pesquisa (AECE)
  • Área: Planejamento Analytics
  • Diretoria : Digital
  • Modelo de trabalho : Híbrido
  • Jornada de trabalho : 220h/mês


Responsabilidades:

MLOps (IA Tradicional)

  • Projetar e manter pipelines CI/CD para treinamento, validacao e deploy de modelos de ML (MLflow,
  • Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines)
  • Implementar IaC para ambientes de ML em cloud (GCP primario), incluindo GPU provisioning e
  • autoscaling
  • Construir e gerenciar feature stores, model registries e pipelines de dados para treinamento
  • Monitoramento de modelos em producao: data drift, concept drift, performance degradation (Evidently,
  • Whylogs, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Garantir reproducibilidade de experimentos com versionamento de dados (DVC, lakeFS) e modelos

LLMOps (IA Generativa & Agentic AI)

  • Operar e otimizar serving de LLMs (vLLM, TGI, Triton) com foco em latencia, throughput e custo
  • Desenvolver pipelines de RAG end-to-end: ingestao, chunking, embedding, vector stores (Pinecone,
  • Weaviate, pgvector, Qdrant)
  • Versionamento de prompts, avaliacao sistematica de saidas (evals) e A/B testing de configuracoes de LLM
  • Gerenciar custo de inferencia: caching inteligente, routing entre modelos, otimizacao de tokens e batching
  • Construir infraestrutura para agentes autonomos (AgentOps): orquestracao, observabilidade, guardrails e
  • circuit breakers
  • Guardrails de seguranca para LLMs: content filtering, PII detection, compliance LGPD/HIPAA

Transversal

  • Governanca, seguranca (RBAC, auditoria) e compliance regulatorio em todo o ciclo de vida
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de software e times de produto
  • Documentar padroes, runbooks e boas praticas para escalar o conhecimento no time


Requisitos

Imprescindíveis:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em MLOps, ML Engineering ou Data/Platform Engineering, com foco em ambientes de produção
  • Solida experiência em implantação de modelos de ML em produção (não apenas em experimentação ou notebooks)
  • Experiência em práticas com workloads de IA generativa (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning ou agentes)
  • Python avançado e proficiência em frameworks de ML (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost)
  • Containers e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (GKE/EKS), Helm
  • Cloud: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Artifact Registry) ou equivalente AWS/Azure
  • IaC: Terraform, Pulumi ou CloudFormation
  • CI/CD para ML: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD
  • Plataformas de ML: MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI Pipelines ou Metaflow
  • APIs de LLM e frameworks GenAI: OpenAI API, Anthropic API, LangChain, LlamaIndex
  • Git avançado, versionamento de dados (DVC, lakeFS) e versionamento de modelos
  • Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, Evidently AI ou Whylogs

Desejáveis:

  • Experiencia com fine-tuning de LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT) e alinhamento (RLHF/DPO)
  • Serving de modelos em GPU com otimizacao (quantizacao, batching dinamico, vLLM, TensorRT)
  • Pipelines de RAG em producao: embeddings, reranking, vector databases em escala
  • Evals e benchmarks sistematicos para LLMs (ragas, deepeval, promptfoo)
  • Orquestracao de agentes de IA (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen ou similares)
  • Certificacoes cloud (GCP Professional ML Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, Azure AI Engineer)



Einstein Benefícios – Compartilhando Bem-Estar

  • Cuidados com a saúde: Programa Cuidar com serviços realizados no Einstein para promover a saúde e bem-estar dos colaboradores e dependentes, Clínicas Einstein, Telemedicina, Convênio Farmácia, Convênio Médico, Assistência Odontológica e Consultório Dental in Company.
  • Bem-Estar: Wellhub (Gympass), TotalPass, Coral, Programa de Orientação Pessoal e SESC.
  • Para você e sua família: Licença paternidade estendida, Seguro de Vida, Creche ou Auxílio Creche para mães ou pais com guarda legal, Auxílio para Filhos com Deficiência e Previdência Privada com taxa zero.
  • Alimentação: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição ou Refeitório no local de trabalho.
  • Mobilidade: Vale Transporte, Fretado, Estacionamento, Aplicativo de Caronas e Circular Metrô.
  • Clube de Benefícios: Para economizar e obter vantagens nas compras de produtos e serviços de diversas categorias, como Beleza e Fitness, Comer e Beber, Compras, Cultura e Lazer, Educação Ensino Einstein, Turismo e muito mais.
  • Programa Mais Conectados: Trabalho remoto nas modalidades Teletrabalho ou Híbrido conforme atividade e área de atuação.


**Os benefícios podem sofrer alteração de acordo com a convenção coletiva, unidade de trabalho e políticas vigentes.

title: Head Of Gaming, Brazil
description:
At bet365, we're one of the world's leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 9,000 people and serve over 100 million customers in 27 languages. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, offering an unmatched experience across 96 sports and 700,000 streaming events. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe, we handle over 6 billion HTTP requests daily and process more than 2 million bets per hour at peak.


We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of opportunities for growth, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide.


Job Description


As the Head of Gaming, Brazil, you will lead strategic initiatives to enhance our gaming portfolio across Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo and will be responsible for the financial performance of gaming operations in the region, executing the strategy set by the CPO and ensuring alignment with the overall business strategy, while maximising player engagement and revenue growth.


We are looking for a dynamic and experienced leader with a proven track record in the iGaming industry who possesses strong commercial acumen, exceptional leadership skills, and a deep understanding of what makes an exceptional localised Gaming Product.


You will develop and execute a comprehensive gaming strategy tailored to the Brazilian market, collaborating closely with the central Product team. This strategy will aim to achieve set financial targets for Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo in each market.


Your role will involve identifying growth opportunities and ensuring the delivery of product and content roadmaps in the region. You will leverage customer and data insights to inform strategies, working with marketing and CRM teams to ensure their approaches align with key product initiatives. Additionally, you will build and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.


Qualifications


  • Significant experience in a senior role within the iGaming industry.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth and operational excellence.
  • In-depth knowledge of games and game types within Casino, Live Casino, Poker, and Bingo.
  • Exceptional leadership and team management skills.
  • Experience in product development and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent analytical and strategic thinking abilities.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience with supplier management.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Passion for innovation and enhancing player experiences.
  • Familiarity with market research and competitive analysis.


Additional Information


  • Developing and executing a comprehensive gaming strategy tailored to Brazil while ensuring it meets and exceeds financial targets for gaming revenue.
  • Identifying and evaluating growth opportunities, including new market expansions, partnerships, and product offerings.
  • Developing and executing a commercial strategy that aligns with regional objectives, working closely with central commercial teams to maximise revenue opportunities.
  • Overseeing the end-to-end product lifecycle for gaming offerings, working with the central Product teams to ensure that products are tailored to meet market preferences and requirements.
  • Establishing clear milestones and timelines for game releases, updates, and integrations, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high quality.
  • Collaborating with Marketing and CRM teams to optimise player engagement and offers, and design tailored promotions and rewards for players in Brazil.
  • Leveraging customer and data insights to inform strategies and decision-making, and conducting market research and competitive analysis to inform product development and identify emerging trends and customer needs.
  • Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing gaming team, fostering a culture of collaboration.
  • Taking responsibility for the financial performance of Gaming in the region, ensuring that revenue targets are met and profitability is maximised, while regularly reporting performance metrics to the CPO and other key stakeholders.
  • Serving as the voice of the customer, ensuring Gaming products address player needs.

Apoia, desenvolve e executa estratégias da empresa relacionadas à operação/gestão de um imóvel, orientando os integrantes da equipe, implementando e melhorando continuamente para que o imóvel atenda e supere as metas financeiras orçadas. Para nós, a experiência na liderança de equipes comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente é muito importante. Na verdade, procuramos complementar-nos com experiências de outras áreas e organizações, onde o “know-how” pode ser transferível e a multitarefa e a priorização de atividades estão presentes.

title: Usuário Final Do Arquiteto De Domínio

Estamos buscando um Usuário Final do Arquiteto de Domínio , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em um contrato CLT, remoto .



Descrição do cargo:

O Arquiteto de Domínio – Computação do Usuário Final tem a responsabilidade de projetar, governar e evoluir as arquiteturas que suportam a experiência do usuário final nas operações da Brasil e Canadá. Isso inclui dispositivos, desktops, laptops, dispositivos móveis, virtualização, colaboração, suporte remoto e soluções de espaço de trabalho digital. O objetivo é oferecer ambientes modernos, seguros e eficientes, alinhados às necessidades dos usuários, garantindo alta disponibilidade, facilidade de uso e integração com plataformas corporativas.

Esse profissional trabalhará colaborativamente para implementar soluções inovadoras que promovam produtividade, segurança, automação e mobilidade, respeitando a governança internacional e os padrões de segurança, e com uma visão clara de transformação digital centrada no usuário.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir e manter arquiteturas de ponta a ponta para ambientes de Computação do Usuário Final (EUC), abrangendo dispositivos físicos, virtuais, móveis, desktops virtuais (VDI), BYOD e de colaboração.
  • Estabelecer padrões e estruturas para provisionamento, gerenciamento e segurança de dispositivos, incluindo políticas de acesso, controle de identidade (IAM), criptografia e proteção contra ameaças.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização e transformação digital para espaços de trabalho inteligentes, com foco em automação, autoatendimento, integração com nuvem, colaboração (MS Teams, Zoom) e aplicações móveis.
  • Avaliar e implementar virtualização, gerenciamento de dispositivos móveis (MDM), segurança de endpoints (EDR), zero-trust, monitoramento e tecnologias de suporte remoto.
  • Trabalhe proativamente para resolver desafios de desempenho, escalabilidade e disponibilidade, garantindo suporte para trabalho remoto e híbrido.
  • Colabore com TI, segurança, negócios e operações para alinhar as demandas e promover a melhor experiência do usuário final.
  • Promover uma governança eficaz, cumprindo as regulamentações globais (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) e as políticas internas.
  • Produzir documentação completa, guias, planos de contingência, treinamentos e melhores práticas para equipes de apoio e operações.
  • Participe de fóruns, workshops e projetos de inovação para manter o ambiente tecnológico alinhado com as tendências globais.

Requisitos e Competências

Requisitos Essenciais (Habilidades Técnicas)

  • Ensino superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas similares.
  • Sólida experiência (mínimo 8 anos) em arquitetura, gestão e inovação do ambiente de Computação para Usuários Finais, em empresas globais ou setores altamente complexos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas e ferramentas EUC: Microsoft 365, Windows Desktop, macOS, VDI (Citrix, VMware Horizon), MDM (Intune, MobileIron), ferramentas de colaboração (Teams, Zoom).
  • Expertise em segurança de dispositivos, zero trust, gerenciamento de identidade e acesso (Azure AD, Okta), criptografia, proteção de endpoints, automação e monitoramento.
  • Experiência com ambientes de trabalho híbridos e remotos, suporte técnico avançado e estratégias para maximizar produtividade e segurança.
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação técnica global, português avançado para alinhamento Brasil-Canadá.


Habilidades Interpessoais

  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com equipes técnicas, usuários finais e executivos.
  • Habilidades analíticas, orientação para soluções e inovação centrada no usuário.
  • Liderança, influência e capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes multiculturais e colaborativos.
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em entregar valor contínuo.

Diferenciais / Bom ter:

  • Certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, Prince2) ou Gestão de Mudanças (PROSCI Certified Change Practitioner).
  • Experiência específica no setor de mineração, transformação digital ou grandes iniciativas globais.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas digitais para Gestão de Mudanças e comunicação colaborativa (MS Teams, SharePoint, Yammer, etc.).

Habilidades e Entregáveis Esperadas, Impacto:

  • Arquitetura sólida e escalável do ambiente de computação para usuários finais para, Brasil e Canadá.
  • Modernização e automação dos espaços de trabalho, com melhorias substanciais na experiência do usuário final.
  • Garantindo segurança, conformidade e disponibilidade em ambientes distribuídos e híbridos.
  • Liderança na divulgação de melhores práticas, treinamento e qualificação de equipes regionais.
  • Suporte para transformação digital e inovação focada no usuário em ambientes de alta complexidade operacional.


Comentários adicionais:

Domain Architect – Computação para Usuários Finais é essencial para garantir que as operações no Brasil e Canadá tenham uma experiência digital unificada, segura e eficiente, apoiando os desafios atuais de mobilidade, segurança e produtividade em ambientes híbridos.

title: Technical Solution Engineer - Sao Paulo
description:
About CATL

CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy!

CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years.


Job Description


ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences.


Responsibilities:


  1. Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications
  2. Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities
  3. Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs
  4. Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user’s manual, disposal proposal, etc.,
  5. Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise
  6. Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement
  7. Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed
  8. Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs


Requirements and skills:


  1. Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo
  2. At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market
  3. Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous
  4. Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous
  5. Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous
  6. Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
  7. Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities
  8. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  9. Superb collaboration and communication
  10. Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities
  11. Proficient in English & Portuguese

title: Regulador De Sinistros Sênior Cyber
description:
Regulador(a) de Sinistros Sênior – Especialista Cyber


PROPÓSITO PRINCIPAL

Atuar na regulação end-to-end de sinistros Cyber , conduzindo o caso desde o aviso de sinistro (FNOL) até o encerramento, com foco na investigação da causa, orientação de cobertura, coordenação de especialistas, quantificação de perdas e emissão de recomendação técnica de indenização, garantindo rastreabilidade, governança e excelência técnica.


PRINCIPAIS FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES

- Conduzir sinistros Cyber first-party e third-party de forma completa (end-to-end), incluindo eventos de ransomware, vazamento de dados (data breach ), interrupção de negócios e falhas tecnológicas.

- Coordenar a resposta a incidentes e a gestão de crise, mobilizando e governando especialistas forenses, jurídicos, de contabilidade forense, comunicação e provedores de resposta a vazamento.

- Analisar a causa, o vetor e a extensão do incidente, consolidando cronologia, evidências e impactos segurados.

- Interpretar e orientar a cobertura de apólices Cyber (gatilhos, exclusões, sub-limites, franquias e períodos de carência (waiting periods) ).

- Controlar, auditar e validar custos de resposta, mitigação e recuperação, assegurando aderência às regras do programa.

- Conduzir quantificação robusta de perdas, incluindo Interrupção de Negócios (Business Interruption – BI), despesas adicionais e demais danos cobertos.

- Gerenciar demandas de terceiros e a resposta a vazamento de dados, quando aplicável, mantendo governança de comunicação e de custos.

- Elaborar relatórios técnicos de regulação (preliminar e final) e emitir recomendação de indenização/ajuste final.

- Manter comunicação clara e estruturada com seguradoras, segurados e demais stakeholders, inclusive em nível executivo.

- Registrar todas as etapas do sinistro em sistemas, garantindo documentação adequada, rastreabilidade e suporte a auditoria.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS

- Atuar de forma remota/virtual (desk ) e, quando necessário, in loco , inclusive em incidentes críticos.

- Participar de revisões pós-incidente (post-incident review ) e contribuir com recomendações de mitigação e melhoria contínua.


REQUISITOS

Formação

- Ensino superior completo.

- Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas (Gestão de Riscos, Tecnologia, Segurança da Informação, Finanças, Auditoria ou Direito Empresarial) é desejável.

Experiência

- Experiência sólida em regulação/ajuste de sinistros complexos, com atuação end-to-end.

- Experiência comprovada em sinistros Cyber e de tecnologia, incluindo coordenação de especialistas.

- Vivência em Interrupção de Negócios (BI) e validação de despesas adicionais é altamente desejável.

- Experiência em ambientes de alta confidencialidade e na gestão de incidentes críticos.

Habilidades e Conhecimentos

- Conhecimento prático em resposta a incidentes Cyber (ransomware, vazamento de dados, exfiltração, contenção e recuperação).

- Capacidade de interpretar apólices Cyber e estruturar posicionamento de cobertura com base técnica.

- Forte habilidade analítica para quantificação de perdas e controle de custos.

- Comunicação clara, estruturada e executiva (oral e escrita).

- Organização, rigor documental e atenção a detalhes.

- Capacidade de atuar sob pressão, liderar em cenários de crise e gerenciar múltiplos stakeholders.

- Inglês avançado/fluente é altamente desejável;
espanhol é diferencial.


CERTIFICAÇÕES DESEJÁVEIS (NÃO OBRIGATÓRIAS)

- CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIH, GCFA, GREM), ISO/IEC 27001.

- Certificações em privacidade e proteção de dados (IAPP, LGPD).

- Certificações em claims, contabilidade forense, Interrupção de Negócios (BI) ou fraude (ex.: CPCU, AIC, CFE).

title: Senior Concept Artist Ii
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are currently seeking a Senior Concept Artist II to join our Art Team. This role focuses on translating the Art Director’s vision into unique and compelling designs for our products. The Senior Concept Artist will also collaborate closely with the Creative Art Lead to support the development of publishing and marketing assets, ensuring consistency and visual excellence.


If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV and include the link to your *portfolio* in it.

  • Work closely with the Creative Art Lead to support the creative process and translate in-game designs into clear visual assets for campaigns.
  • Partner with production, marketing, and product teams to ensure campaign visuals align with objectives, timelines, and business goals.
  • Participate actively in the Art Team's and the Creative Studio's discussions and reviews to develop new ideas for our projects.
  • Interface with external vendors to collaborate on the development of our projects.


Main job requirements:

  • Completed higher education degree in Graphic Design, Game Design, Animation, Marketing, or related fields.
  • Proven experience (5+ years) in game art and/or animation.
  • Excellent command of art principles, including composition, scale, perspective, light, color, and form.
  • Solid knowledge of creative pipelines, campaign production workflows, and collaboration with external partners.
  • Strong use of AI tools to develop in-game and campaign assets with agility.
  • Visual and graphic design skills are highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of 3D software is a plus.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills in English and Portuguese (written and spoken), with experience collaborating with internal teams and external partners.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving challenges.
  • Passion for games and a strong understanding of gaming culture and player motivations.
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (hybrid mode).

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative

Job level: Jr Analyst

Department: LATAM Sales &Marketing

Reports To: Service & Warranty Manager for LATAM

Location: Indaiatuba City, São Paulo, Brazil


SVP Worldwide is the world’s largest consumer sewing machine company, proudly home to the iconic brands SINGER® , HUSQVARNA® VIKING® , PFAFF® , and CREATIVATE™ . Together, our brands represent nearly 500 years of combined leadership , empowering sewists around the world and shaping the evolution of sewing for generations.


Our purpose is clear: to create, elevate, and celebrate sewists around the world .


With global operations spanning R&D, manufacturing, distribution, and sales, SVP Worldwide brings together heritage craftsmanship and modern innovation to serve a worldwide community of makers.


Our expanding portfolio includes sewing and embroidery machines, accessories and notions, garment care, and creative software — offering meaningful opportunities to innovate, collaborate, and make an impact.


Guided by our values — customer-first thinking, curiosity and creativity, inclusion, and transparency — we’re building a connected, inclusive culture where people can grow their careers while helping define the future of sewing.


Position Summary

We are looking for a professional to manage nationwide sales of maintenance parts for domestic and industrial sewing machines. This role will maintain the current customer portfolio, visiting distributors in São Paulo city and supporting clients in other regions remotely. Responsibilities include managing quotes, orders, follow‑ups, and providing inputs for sales forecasting.

Later on, the role will also focus on expanding business with existing Singer‑registered dealers, in partnership with the Channel Sales Executives.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and support the current customer base, acting as the main contact for maintenance parts orders (quotation, order placement, and follow‑up).
  • Drive sales activities within the existing portfolio.
  • Identify opportunities within the current customer base (Dealers) to expand maintenance parts sales.
  • Conduct proactive outreach and sales initiatives to grow business with existing accounts.
  • Provide accurate information to support sales forecasting and the S&OP process.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms according to established commercial policies.
  • Annual sales volume: R$ 3.5M.
  • Customer base: around 160 direct clients, including 11 distributors (7 located in São Paulo city).


Requirements and preferred experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed.
  • Previous experience in sales and knowledge of the maintenance parts business is a plus.
  • Knowledge of sales and negotiation techniques.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.


Languages:

  • Advanced English (mandatory) — ability to operate in a global corporate environment.
  • Intermediate Spanish — to support Latin American operations.


Skills, Abilities and knowledge:

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal relationship abilities.
  • Relationship‑driven sales approach, with a strong orientation toward results and portfolio growth.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.


We offer you:

  • Benefits: medical and life insurance, food basket (or card), canteen at the factory
  • Profit Sharing Program
  • Hybrid work schedule
  • Work environment that harbors a culture of collaboration and community
  • Learning and development opportunities


Work Environment / Location / Flexibility

SVP Worldwide offers a fast-paced and ever-evolving environment. As part of our Flexible Workplace Policy, this position follows a hybrid work model 3 days per week on-site at our headquarters in Indaiatuba, São Paulo .


Why You Will Love Being Part of SVP Worldwide

We take care of our team! We offer a competitive benefits package, including multiple healthcare plan options, on-site meals, grocery allowance or meal vouchers, pharmacy benefits, profit sharing, life insurance, and educational partnerships.


At SVP Worldwide, we celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion and strive to build a workforce reflective of our global consumers. This means understanding, respecting, and valuing diverse styles, experiences, identities, ideas, and opinions while being inclusive of all people.

SVP Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, nationality, citizenship, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status.


In the News

In 2021, SVP Worldwide was acquired by Platinum Equity , a global investment firm with more than $25 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of approximately 50 operating companies serving customers worldwide. Platinum Equity is fully committed to supporting SVP Worldwide’s continued growth by providing additional financial and operational resources to accelerate the company’s efforts.

title: Loss Prevention
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

Guarulhos – SP | 100% Presencial

Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention AVSEC. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure full compliance with ANAC regulations and the Air Cargo Security Program (PSESCA)
  • Oversee cargo screening processes and security controls within the operation
  • Monitor and enforce access control procedures in restricted airport areas
  • Act as the main point of contact with regulatory authorities (ANAC, Federal Police, Customs, airport stakeholders)
  • Conduct risk assessments and identify operational vulnerabilities, proposing mitigation actions
  • Lead investigations related to security incidents and loss prevention, ensuring proper documentation and follow-up
  • Develop and implement action plans to improve security processes and prevent losses
  • Manage third-party security providers, ensuring service level, training compliance, and performance standards
  • Ensure all required AVSEC trainings and certifications are up to date for employees and contractors


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Relevant experience in security, loss prevention, risk management, or similar areas
  • Experience in regulated environments (e.G., airport operations, air cargo, logistics, or distribution centers)
  • Knowledge of ANAC regulations and AVSEC/PSESCA is highly desirable
  • Experience managing third-party security providers or contract security teams
  • Strong investigative and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently with a high level of ownership and accountability
  • Advanced English (written and verbal) – required

title: Wireless Engineer
description:
Job Title: Wireless Network Optimization Engineer (4G/5G)

Job Summary:

The Wireless Network Optimization Engineer is responsible for improving the performance, capacity, and quality of mobile networks (LTE/4G and NR/5G). This role involves analyzing network KPIs, identifying issues, and implementing optimization strategies to enhance user experience and network efficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and analyze network performance KPIs (e.G., accessibility, retainability, mobility, throughput)
  • Perform optimization for 4G LTE and 5G NR networks
  • Conduct drive tests and post-processing analysis using tools like TEMS, Nemo, or similar
  • Identify coverage and capacity issues and propose solutions (tilt, azimuth, parameter tuning)
  • Optimize parameters such as handovers, power control, load balancing, and interference mitigation
  • Support network rollout, integration, and acceptance activities
  • Analyze OSS data and generate performance reports
  • Work closely with RF planning, transmission, and core network teams
  • Troubleshoot customer complaints and network degradation issues
  • Ensure SLA compliance and continuous network improvement


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • Experience with RF optimization and performance tuning
  • Experience with major vendors (Huawei, Ericsson, Nokia, ZTE) is a plus
  • 3–7+ years in wireless network optimization or RF engineering
  • Advanced English
  • Work on site mode


Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and reporting abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Team collaboration and stakeholder management


Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Life insurance.

- Birthday day off.

- Gympass / Totalpass.

Descrição sumária:

O Engenheiro Sênior em Engenharia de Estimativa & Viabilidade é responsável por liderar e aprovar atividades técnicas relacionadas a estimativas de custos e análise de projetos. Este profissional assegura a qualidade das entregas e a satisfação do cliente, aplicando sua vasta experiência para desenvolver soluções que atendam às exigências dos projetos.

Suas responsabilidades incluem a supervisão da elaboração de estimativas complexas, a realização de análises detalhadas de viabilidade e a validação de relatórios técnicos. O Engenheiro Sênior também atua como um ponto de referência para a equipe, promovendo a adoção de melhores práticas e assegurando a conformidade com os padrões da indústria. Além disso, ele orienta e mentoriza profissionais menos experientes, facilitando o desenvolvimento de habilidades e conhecimentos técnicos dentro da equipe. Sua liderança é fundamental para garantir a execução bem-sucedida dos projetos e para fortalecer a relação com os clientes.

Principais atribuições:

- Elaborar estimativas de custos para projetos de engenharia, considerando materiais, mão de obra, equipamentos e outros recursos necessários.

- Elaborar especificações e documentação técnica para compreender os requisitos e identificar os elementos de custo e divergências de escopo.

- Elaborar planilhas de quantidades e custos para cada fase do projeto, utilizando software especializado quando aplicável.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Gerente Médico De Segurança Clínica
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.


Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.

  • Supervisionar e coordenar atividades médicas relacionadas à farmacovigilância e segurança clínica dos produtos do portfólio.
  • Atuar no monitoramento de segurança dos participantes de estudos clínicos e estudos de pós-comercialização.
  • Contribuir na identificação, avaliação e classificação de eventos adversos e na definição de causalidade.
  • Elaborar e revisar relatórios de segurança clínica, incluindo RPBR, PGR, DSURs, protocolos, bulas e demais documentos regulatórios.
  • Atuar na elaboração e revisão de documentos científicos e regulatórios dos estudos clínicos e pós-comercialização, como protocolos, CRFs, diário do
  • participante, brochura do investigador e planos de gerenciamento de segurança.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com o Gerente Médico de Desenvolvimento Clínico na avaliação de segurança dos produtos experimentais e aprovados.
  • Participar de reuniões com agências reguladoras, comitês de monitoramento de dados (DSMB) e demais parceiros externos.
  • Coordenar a análise de dados de segurança clínica provenientes de estudos, SAC e farmacovigilância.
  • Contribuir na criação e manutenção de bancos de dados de segurança.
  • Avaliar dados de segurança provenientes da literatura científica e outras fontes externas.
  • Atuar na elaboração de artigos científicos originários das atividades da Diretoria Médica ou do Centro de Segurança Clínica.
  • Representar o Instituto Butantan nacional e internacionalmente em temas relacionados à segurança clínica, quando solicitado.
  • Contribuir com atividades de ensino, capacitação e eventos técnico-científicos relacionados à farmacovigilância e segurança clínica, quando
  • solicitado.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas médicas internas e externas relacionadas à segurança dos produtos do Instituto Butantan.
  • Apoiar na construção de estratégias de gestão de risco relacionadas ao portfólio de produtos do Instituto Butantan.
  • Participar da elaboração ou revisão de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs) e outros documentos institucionais


Formação e requisitos imprescindíveis


  • Graduação em Medicina, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Especialização e/ou pós-graduação nas áreas de: Doenças Infecciosas;
    Pediatria;
    Farmacovigilância;
    Vacinologia;
    Farmacoepidemiologia;
    Epidemiologia;
    Pesquisa Clínica.
  • Atuação prévia em áreas médicas ligadas à segurança clínica, farmacovigilância ou pesquisa clínica.
  • Desejável experiência com vacinas e doenças infecciosas.
  • Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento de legislação e boas práticas de farmacovigilância e pesquisa clínica.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados clínicos e produção científica.
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Nosso pacote de benefícios:


  • Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;
  • Convênio Médicoe convênio odontológico;
  • Plano de Aposentadoria Complementar:
  • TotalPass;
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Cartão Ifood Benefícios;

  • Subsídio de medicamentos;
  • Parcerias na área Educacional e Entretenimento;
  • Acesso aos museus do Instituto Butantan;
  • Day Off de aniversário.


Informações complementares:

  • Horário de trabalho: comercial

title: Assistant/Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Assistant/Finance Manager (Coordenador Financeiro) will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Financial Controller (Global HQ).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • 7 - 10 years of experience in finance and tax management within a manufacturing environment, including at least 3 years of experience in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Merchant Operations Manager
description:
About the Role

As a Merchant Operations Manager, you will be at the forefront of ensuring flawless merchant operations. You will create scalable tools and processes to support local teams in achieving outstanding experience targets. This role requires daily interaction with City Leads and Account Managers, a deep understanding of key merchants, and the ability to extract actionable insights that drive mid-term strategies, making every delivery great.


What You'll Do

  • Merchant Operations : Work closely with commercial teams to identify key operational opportunities and reduce defects, driving continuous improvement across the merchant base.
  • End-to-End Project Management : Lead cross-functional projects from scoping to delivery, using structured project management methods to plan & execute key projects idenpendently toward clear business goals.
  • Problem Solving : Identify root causes of risks and opportunities, develop multiple actionable solutions, and evaluate tradeoffs to recommend the best path forward.
  • Process Optimization : Execute, optimize, and scale core analyses and processes — establishing standardized workflows that improve team efficiency and are regularly reviewed for performance.
  • Product & Tool Development : Identify merchant needs and pain points;
    partner with product and Product teams to support the implementation from merchant/sales-side tools and capabilities that improve online operational efficiency.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with commercial teams to understand pain points and identify system and process improvements with local & global team members.


Basic Qualifications

  • Experience : At least 5 years of professional experience in merchant operations, delivery roles, logistics, business operations, strategy operations, or related field.
  • End-to-End Ownership : Demonstrated ability to lead projects from conception through execution, coordinating across strategy, product, and operations teams to deliver results idependently.
  • Execution Excellence : Ability to manage and prioritize complex workstreams, collaborate across teams, and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving environment while maintaining high standards.
  • Data-Driven Mindset : Ability to make strategic decisions based on data analysis. Comfortable working deeply with data while maintaining a big-picture perspective. Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, with experience in reporting, experimentation, and scaling processes or products.
  • Planning & Organization : Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects, including defining timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and resource allocation.
  • Communication : Proficiency in English. Ability to clearly interpret and present data to diverse audiences in an engaging and concise way.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical Skills : Strong SQL and Excel skills. Experience with databases or programming languages such as SQL & Python is a plus.
  • 0-to-1 Experience: Track record of building processes, tools, or products from scratch in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Industry Background : Prior experience in food delivery, e-commerce, or startup within operations industries is preferred.

  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

VR ou Refeitório,VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

Realizar as atividades de Geologia de Mina, com segurança, qualidade e produtividade, foco em excelência operacional. Apoiar na realização de inspeções de taludes, monitoramentos geotécnicos e hidrogeológicos, com reportes relacionados as atividades e suporte as equipes correlatas.

- Atuar na elaboração do planejamento e execução de sondagens de curto prazo, garantindo a aquisição de todos os dados técnicos;

- Realizar a elaboração e execução do plano de amostragens diversas de geologia, geotecnia e geometalurgia, conforme procedimentos para suportar a construção dos modelos de curto, médio e longo prazo;

Elaborando o modelamento geológico, identificando os corpos de minério e estéril da mina, por meio de interpretações dos furos e mapas geológicos, visando gerar modelo de blocos com teores de minerais e subsidiar o planejamento de lavra;

- Realizar inspeções de campo (mina, depósitos de estéril, laboratórios e outras áreas respectivas à operação de mina);

- Consolidar e analisar os relatórios mensais de Produção e compilar reportes para a liderança imediata, visando subsidiar tomadas de decisão;

- Realizar interpretações geológicas e geotécnicas de seções do depósitos a fim de mensurar o potencial de exploração da mina;

- Suporte ao time de planejamento e mina em relação a melhorias na disposição de estéril, desmonte de rochas, lavras de minério, apoiando também as áreas de projeto nos estudos locacionais realizados, entre outros;

- Apoiar na revisão dos procedimentos operacionais da área, conforme necessidade identificada, visando otimizar as atividades, com foco na segurança, prazo e qualidade;

- Acompanhar as atividades de empresas terceirizadas, orientando tecnicamente e avaliando as atividades realizadas, bem como validar boletins de medições, visando assegurar a qualidade do serviço entregue;

- Atuar no acompanhamento e controle dos custos OPEX e CAPEX da área.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

vaga de Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior

title: Trainee Comercial
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting, acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 8.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

Nosso objetivo é construir um futuro mais inteligente e sustentável, impulsionando a inovação e o crescimento de nossos clientes e de nossos talentos.


Descrição da vaga – Trainee Business Manager

Como Trainee Business Manager, você iniciará sua carreira com uma visão 360º do negócio, sendo acompanhado(a) de perto por lideranças experientes para desenvolver habilidades comerciais, estratégicas e de gestão.


Ao longo do programa, você terá a oportunidade de aprender a construir e desenvolver uma Unidade de Negócio, atuando progressivamente nos principais pilares da função.


Suas responsabilidades (com acompanhamento e treinamento)

Negócios e Estratégia

  • Apoiar no mapeamento de mercado, clientes e oportunidades de negócio.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de propostas comerciais e apresentações para clientes.
  • Participar de reuniões comerciais e de qualificação com clientes e consultores.
  • Contribuir com análises de desempenho e acompanhamento de projetos.


Relacionamento com Clientes

  • Apoiar na gestão e atualização do portfólio de clientes.
  • Participar de interações com clientes para entender necessidades e oportunidades.
  • Contribuir na construção de relacionamentos comerciais de longo prazo.


Gestão Financeira

  • Apoiar na análise de indicadores financeiros básicos (receita, margem, faturamento).
  • Contribuir com relatórios e análises de rentabilidade.
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento do desempenho financeiro dos projetos.


Gestão de Equipe

  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento da equipe de consultores.
  • Apoiar na organização de processos internos e iniciativas de melhoria.


Recursos Humanos

  • Participar do processo de recrutamento de consultores (triagem, entrevistas e feedbacks).
  • Apoiar no acompanhamento de carreira e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa (Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas) entre dez. 2023 até dez. 2025.
  • Interesse em carreira comercial e gestão de negócios.
  • Interesse pelo mercado de tecnologia e consultoria.
  • Excelente comunicação e perfil analítico.
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório).
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial e eventuais viagens.


O que oferecemos

  • Programa estruturado de desenvolvimento com acompanhamento próximo de líderes.
  • Ambiente internacional com exposição a projetos globais.
  • Plano de carreira acelerado, com possibilidade de evolução para posições de liderança.
  • Contato direto com clientes e diferentes indústrias.
  • Cultura que valoriza aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e crescimento profissional.
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro.


Diversidade e Inclusão

Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

title: Cientista De Dados Jr
description:

- Domínio de linguagens de programação Python e SQL.

- Experiência com Big Data, ETL, Data Wrangling e visualização de dados.
